description:
At Farmhouse Metal Decor, we create handcrafted, American-made metal signs designed to bring warmth, personality, and timeless charm to homes, farms, and ranches. Each piece is precision laser-cut from premium steel and finished with a weather-resistant powder coating, making it perfect for both indoor and outdoor display. From personalized family name signs to equestrian, farm, and memorial pieces, every order is made-to-order with care and attention to detail.

What Makes Us Different

• Proudly made in the USA with high-quality steel
• ✨ Fully customizable designs tailored to each customer
• 🛠️ Built to last with durable, weather-resistant finishes
• 🤝 Personalized customer service from design to delivery
• 🏡 Designed specifically for farmhouse, ranch, and rustic lifestyles

1. Approving & Denying Registration

We reserve the right, in our sole and absolute discretion, to approve or deny any Affiliate Program registration. If your registration is denied, you will have no legal recourse against us.

An Affiliate link is generated automatically, but you may also create one for a single product or collection. If a customer clicks on another Affiliate's link and afterward clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliates may promote farmhousehollow.com on social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram, as well as in print publications such as magazines and newspapers.

If you refer a customer to our website and they place an order, you will be paid a commission based on the applicable commission structure. The commission amount is determined by the order value and does not include additional fees such as tax or shipping.

You must set your payment details in your Affiliate account settings to receive commissions. Payments are made only for transactions that complete successfully.

The Affiliate Program is governed by a fair usage policy, which allows the merchant to review each and every conversion. Share your network link with other Affiliates to invite them to join. Anyone who clicks the link and registers becomes your downline Affiliate.

6. Cookies

We track customers who click your link using cookies, so they must have cookies enabled for us to track them. We cannot track a user who blocks cookies or clears them, and we cannot pay commissions on that person's activity.

The cookie duration is specified in the Affiliate signup form. Tracking begins when a customer clicks your Affiliate link or applies your coupon. During the cookie period, every purchase that customer makes on our website earns you a commission, and they will not be required to click your link again.

7. Leaving the Affiliate Program

If you would like to be removed from the Program, email us at affiliates@farmhousehollow.com.

We're delighted you've made it this far through this important information, and we wish you the best of luck. You can return to these Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions at any time. If you have any questions, email affiliates@farmhousehollow.com for assistance.
